description: Software Developer • Technology Enthusiast • Hardware Builder
bio: I am a passionate software developer and technology enthusiast who thrives on turning ideas into reality. Currently pursuing my Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA Honours) at BVM Holy Cross College, Cherpunkal, I bring a unique blend of software skills and hardware curiosity to everything I build.

My genuine interests span across software development, hardware projects, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, servers, embedded systems, electronics, and astrophysics. I am constantly exploring the intersections of these fields to architect solutions that are both innovative and technically robust.
